title: Multimodal Cognitive Workload n-back Task, 4 Difficulties
description: This multimodal dataset comprises EEG, ECG, and pupillometry recordings from participants performing an n-back working memory task at four difficulty levels (1-back through 4-back). Data were collected using a combined mobile EEG+ECG system synchronized with a Pupil Labs eye tracker via Lab Streaming Layer, and converted from raw XDF recordings into BIDS format. The dataset is intended to support research on cognitive workload assessment across multiple physiological modalities.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 19-channel 10-20 montage using Ag/AgCl electrodes with linked-ear reference at 250 Hz, with impedance checks and Neurogel applied. ECG was recorded via a 3-lead configuration on the same mobile system. Pupillometry data were collected using a Pupil Labs Pupil Core eye tracker with infrared illuminators, relayed asynchronously via LSL. The n-back task included a tutorial phase with feedback (20 trials per level) and a main experiment (100 trials per level) without feedback, with each trial presenting a letter for 1.0 s followed by a 0.7 s blank interval.
